description: This Java source file defines the EntityEcaUtil class, which provides utility methods for loading, caching, and retrieving Entity Event-Condition-Action (ECA) rules from XML configurations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityEcaUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to load, cache, and retrieve Entity ECA rules from XML configuration files, supporting concurrent processing and integration with OFBiz component resource management.

methods.name: getEntityEcaCache
methods.description: Retrieves or loads the Entity ECA rules cache for a given entity ECA reader name.

methods.name: getEntityEcaReaderName
methods.description: Fetches the name of the Entity ECA reader configuration associated with a given delegator name.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Loads ECA rules from specified resources and populates the cache.

methods.name: getEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Parses ECA rules from a resource handler and returns a list of EntityEcaRule objects.

methods.name: createEcaLoaderCallable
methods.description: Creates a callable task to load ECA rules from a specified resource handler.

methods.name: getEntityEcaRules
methods.description: Provides the set of ECA rules for a specific entity and event.
